meta.name: Dirt — The Movie
meta.description: Made from the same elements as stars, plants, food and human beings, dirt is very much alive and very much just as complex. One teaspoon of dirt contains a billion organisms working in balance to sustain a series of thriving communities that have become pretty much totally invisible to our daily lives.Dirt — The Movietells the story of Earth’s most valuable and underappreciated source of fertility, from its miraculous beginning to its tragic degradation…
